name: Quixotic
fix_description: In fillSellOrder, require that msg.sender == buyer or verify a signature from the buyer authorizing the purchase. Currently only the sell order signature is validated, allowing anyone to force arbitrary addresses to buy worthless NFTs using their approved tokens.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a single-call exploit of an obvious signature/access-control flaw: the marketplace only validates the seller signature and allows an arbitrary buyer parameter. The PoC is very short, requires no flash loans or complex protocol interactions, and a competent auditor could reproduce it quickly once reading the fillSellOrder logic.
